integrity.evidence_basis: Analytic argument and reproducible supplementary finite checks; finite-dimensional cone-angle identities are properly attributed to Kabluchko–Seidel. Independent validation has not been performed.

scientific_limitations: Sharp leading logarithmic index and mean for regular-simplex vertex cones as dimension tends to infinity; finite-dimensional conic intrinsic volume formulas are pre-existing (Kabluchko–Seidel 2020). No CLT, rates, general posets or higher-order terms asserted.
title: Sharp logarithmic statistical dimension of regular simplex cones
